clips.name: Hops and counts the tiles
Plays peekaboo with the lid
Twists side to side with flying arms
Sneaks up for a poke
Plays at being a grave archivist
Marches on the spot like a sentry
Bobs a little bow and flutters a hand
Bounces and waves both arms
Counts off on the fingers
Stretches after long reading
Smooths the robe
Ponders with a finger at the brim
Gazes up into the void
Stifles a yawn behind a hand
Folds the hands and sways
Settles the shell with a click
Tugs the cape straight
Tucks the hands in the sleeves and rocks
Writes a note in the air
Brushes dust from a sleeve
Polishes the lid with a sleeve
Listens for the old shells
Squares the shoulders
Draws into the shell
Shifts and drums the fingers
Ticks off the room at a glance
Starts and snaps shut at a sound
The lid pops up with delight
Hugs it close like a treasured book
Receives it with both hands
Hand to the breast and two nods
A raised palm: no thank you
Hands it back with a small bow
Lets out a breath and softens
Strikes the grievance from the record
Folds the arms and turns away
Drums the fingers on a folded arm
Flinches and ducks into the shell
Staggers to one side
Tips the lid in greeting

A small precise wave

Bows and lowers the lid
Raises a hand and turns to go
Taps the shell: you are noted
Enumerates the points
Raises a finger for a footnote
Opens both palms
Shapes a book in the air
A dry aside behind the hand
Tilts the head and lifts the lid

Notes it down in the palm

Recounts it with the lid bobbing
Nods along slowly
A dry little chuckle
Reads down a page and turns it

Lays out the wares with a flourish
